title: Human methylarginine sites, v1.3.0 (PTM_Pipeline)
description: The human protein arginine methylation sites of DeAngelo, Silverstein & Shechter, Cell Chem Biol 33:1404-1421 (2026), with the code that builds them and the Methylarginine Site Explorer website. v1.3.0 keeps the 11,601 sites on 4,432 proteins of v1.2.0 (and its 2,406 lower-confidence sites) and adds what methylated arginines contact: RNA and DNA in PDB structures, with the bound sequences; RNA- and DNA-binding evidence from living cells (crosslinked residues and peptides, RBDmap, CAPRI, pCLAP, RBR-ID and the DNA interactome), tested within each protein against its other arginines and, at the protein level, among the proteins each experiment measured (the reviewed proteome where it lists none); and what their proteins bind in vitro and in cells (RNA Bind-n-Seq, HTR-SELEX, JASPAR, ENCODE and ENCORE eCLIP). The residue-level analyses (motifs, disorder, domains, structural context, distances to RNA and DNA) are also given within proteins (Mantel-Haenszel, van Elteren). releases/v1.3.0/CHANGES.md says what changed since v1.2.0; v1.2.0, v1.1.0 and the published version (v1.0.0) are also included.
